name: 気分と活動の関係を記録する案内
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset: Lighthouse LH13-0005「気分と活動の関係を記録する案内」, ONE compact Japanese information card.
Reference hierarchy: Image 1 ORIGINAL Insight Timer screenshot, ONLY its bottom Mood influences section, controls alignment, spacing, proportions and fine details. It has centered title and two lines of explanation, no icon/button/data. Image 2 our FigCraft mock is SECONDARY for exact Japanese text and locked Japanese typography. Image 3 approved Lighthouse bus design is STYLE ONLY for white rounded card, subtle neutral outline and soft downward shadow, no map/content.
Create the exact compact information block on pure white #FFFFFF canvas. One white rounded card with fine quiet neutral border and restrained soft downward shadow. Centered title above two centered body lines; no icon, decorative marker, button, tag chip, chart, metric, divider or extra text. Full component visible with modest white margin. Preserve logical proportion 390x142, compact height and comfortable reading.
Exact text:
heading「気分に関わること」
body line 1「チェックインにタグを付けて、」
body line 2「気分に関わることを振り返りましょう。」
Typography locked: Japanese Meiryo Bold 20px/28px heading, Meiryo Regular 14px/24px body, tracking 0. Preserve two body lines and punctuation. Dark ink #1D1D1D, secondary copy #6E6E6E with readable contrast. Avoid oversized heading or all-bold text.
Accent decision: original has no meaningful accent, state or action in this component. Omit color accents; white/neutral is appropriate. Do not invent green decoration or a CTA just to use the official green brand. No mint tint, glow, gloss, gradient page or nested containers. This is a static raster design candidate, no native-editable/application claim.
reviewNotes: 原画下部の案内と日本語モックを実見し、原画を整列/間隔/細部の主参照にした。原画に意味色や操作はないためアクセントなし。生成結果を実見:見出しと2行の日本語本文・句読点・中央揃え・白面・静かな中立線と影・見切れなしを確認。不要なアイコン/ボタン/数値を追加していない。厳密なMeiryo実体は未証明。reviewedは画像候補の視覚レビューのみ、所有者承認/ネイティブ編集/実装ではない。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
